name: GetAIArray
reason: Called with no arguments throughout the stock scripts, where it returns every AI regardless of team. The page's signature line is 'GetAIArray( <team>, <team>, ... )' and it lists one required team, but the team filter is optional in the engine.

name: StartPath
reason: The page contradicts itself: its signature line is 'StartPath()' with no parameters while its Required Args list one node index. The signature line is the truthful half - the vehicle follows the path it is already attached to.

name: Teleport
reason: The angles are optional; teleporting to a position without respecifying the actor's facing is the common call. The page lists both arguments as required.

name: AssertEx
reason: The message is optional, which is what makes AssertEx degrade to Assert rather than fail to compile. The page lists both arguments as required.

name: MakeDvarServerInfo
reason: The value is optional: flagging an existing dvar DVAR_CODINFO without changing it is a valid call. The page lists both arguments as required.

name: BadPlace_Cylinder
reason: The team list is optional - a bad place with no team named is bad for everyone. The page's signature line ends '<team>, <team>...' (variadic) while its Required Args insist on at least one team.
